name: Integrately

sources.title: Integrately — automation platform (Zapier alternative) with a 1,500+ app integrations directory; footer 'SaaS Partners' links: 'Integrate Your Own SaaS' and 'Embed Automation On Your Website'

conditions: The directory is Integrately's own integrations catalog — listing means building a real Integrately integration/partnership ('Integrate Your Own SaaS' partner route), not a generic listing
requirements: A SaaS product with an API worth integrating — the app directory is a feature of the automation platform
'Integrate Your Own SaaS' partner link in the footer under 'SaaS Partners' — partnership, not self-serve listing
Each app entry is an integrations page (e.g., /integrations/<app>) showing ready automations
preparation: A public API or integration endpoints Integrately can wire automations around
Partner contact via the SaaS Partners link
workflow: Use footer 'Integrate Your Own SaaS' to start a partnership
Work with their team to build the app's triggers/actions
Once live, the app appears at integrately.com/integrations/<app> with ready automations
watchFor: Not a launch directory — a SaaS without integratable workflows has no reason to list
Partner onboarding is a business conversation, not a form
The directory's SEO value is real for integration-seeking traffic (e.g., 'X integrations')
countsAsLive: The app has a public integrations page at integrately.com/integrations/<app>
